_comment: Glossary fed to the LLM by scripts/seed-translations.mjs. doNotTranslate terms must appear verbatim in every language (brand names, units, racing abbreviations, third-party names). notes give per-domain guidance so motorsport jargon is rendered idiomatically rather than literally.
notes: This is an AI driving-coach panel for a motorsport telemetry app (karting, sim racing, track days). Use racing terminology a driver would recognise in the target language.

'lap' = a single time around the circuit; 'sector' = a timed segment of a lap; 'corner' = a turn; 'apex' = the clipping point of a corner; 'reference lap' = the lap others are compared against; 'V-Min' = the minimum (apex) speed in a corner.
'lateral g' / 'g' is cornering acceleration; keep the unit symbol 'g' verbatim. 'scrubbing' = tyres sliding/washing out; 'grip' = mechanical traction.
Keep UI text concise — these are headings, labels, chips and short map-popup fragments in a dense dashboard.
Preserve every {{placeholder}} exactly as written; do not translate, reorder, or add them. Keep adjacent placeholders adjacent (e.g. {{sign}}{{meters}}).
Preserve leading/trailing spaces and separators (e.g. the leading ' · ' on some fragments that are concatenated into a line).
